# emap

> `@mapseekai/emap` is a browser-only TypeScript engine for rendering, querying, analysing, and editing topology-oriented vector data. Data lives in mapshaper topology datasets, layers render with Canvas 2D, and every mutation is an undoable command. No backend map service is required.

Current version: 0.12.0. Default documentation locale is Chinese; every page has an English mirror under `/en/`.

## Key facts for code generation

- Install: `pnpm add @mapseekai/emap`; always import `@mapseekai/emap/style.css`.
- Root entry exports `Emap`, `TopologySource`, `Bounds`, edit commands, handlers, and 13 UI controls. Create maps with `await Emap.create({ container })`.
- Optional entry points: `/arrow` (GeoArrow/GeoParquet, needs `apache-arrow`, plus `parquet-wasm` for GeoParquet), `/duckdb` (needs `@duckdb/duckdb-wasm` + `apache-arrow`), `/geopackage` (no extra install; publish `emap-geopackage-worker.js` + `sql-wasm.wasm` for Worker import), `/maplibre` (needs `maplibre-gl`), `/context`, `/services`, `/providers`, `/plugins`, `/presets`, `/ai`.
- Worker execution needs `emap-worker.js` + `mapshaper-vendor.js` published from `dist/`.
- String expressions are disabled by default (`expressionPolicy: 'disabled'`); only set `'trusted'` for application-controlled configuration.
- Operations return `OpResult`; check `result.ok` instead of relying on `try/catch`.
- TypeScript config: `"module": "ESNext"`, `"moduleResolution": "Bundler"`. Requires Chrome/Edge 109+, Firefox 115+, Safari 16.4+.

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/): what emap is and the reading order
- [Installation](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/getting-started/installation): package, stylesheet, optional entry points, peers
- [Your first map](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/getting-started/quick-start): minimal working page
- [Concepts overview](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/concepts/overview): Emap, source, source layer, render layer
- [Emap instance](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/concepts/emap): create, events, lifecycle, dispose
- [Sources and layers](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/concepts/source-layer): import, export, CRS preflight, format plugins
- [Topology model](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/concepts/topology): shared arcs, readonly views
- [Coordinates and CRS](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/concepts/coordinates-crs): three coordinate spaces, reprojection
- [Architecture](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/concepts/architecture): six source zones, native Cordis runtime
- [Styling](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/guides/styling): paint properties, restricted expressions, attribute buckets
- [Events](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/guides/events): on/once/off, feature events
- [Selection](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/guides/selection): select API, click/box/lasso handlers
- [Editing](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/guides/editing): edit handlers, undo/redo, transactions
- [Camera](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/guides/camera): jumpTo/easeTo/flyTo/fitBounds
- [Controls](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/guides/controls): 13 built-in UI controls
- [Web Worker](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/guides/worker): useWorker routing, asset publishing
- [Plugins and presets](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/guides/plugins): Cordis plugins, presets, AI capabilities
- [Data formats](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/data/formats): format matrix, ZIP limits, export
- [Attributes](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/data/attributes): reading/writing attributes, filters, fields
- [Data operations](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/data/operations): the 45 map.ops methods
- [GeoPackage](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/data/geopackage): direct vector import, worker, limits
- [DuckDB](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/data/duckdb): restricted SELECT, spatial toolbox
- [Event reference](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/reference/events): every event and payload
- [Error reference](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/reference/errors): OpError kinds, error classes
- [Compatibility](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/reference/compatibility): browser/Node requirements, peer table
- [FAQ](https://mapseekai.github.io/mapseekai/emap/reference/faq): blank map, invisible layers, failed ops
